person.name: Yiheng Xiao
person.school: Antai College of Economics and Management
person.degree: Undergraduate student, double major in Mathematics and Economics
person.intro: I am an undergraduate student at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, double majoring in mathematics and economics. My research focuses on continuous optimization, including semidefinite programming, primal-dual methods, optimization on manifolds, and online preconditioning.

papers.title: Nearly Optimal Bounds for Orthogonal Trace-Sum Maximization
papers.summary: Nearly optimal noise guarantees for the generalized power method and the semidefinite relaxation of orthogonal trace-sum maximization.

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Convex Low-Rank SDP
papers.summary: A unified theoretical framework for various convex low-rank SDP algorithms, including two new variants of the spectral bundle method proposed in this work.

papers.title: An Online Spectral Bundle Method for Large Scale SDP with Local Linear Convergence
papers.summary: An online spectral bundle method with one subspace update and one reduced projected-gradient step per iteration, with local linear convergence.

papers.title: On the Convergence of Doubly Stochastic Primal-Dual Hybrid Gradient Method
papers.status: Submitted to SIAM Journal on Optimization
papers.summary: Randomized block updates on both primal and dual variables, with ergodic sublinear convergence and linear convergence of a restarted variant.

papers.title: Doubly Stochastic Primal-Dual Hybrid Gradient Method for Saddle-Point Problems with Nonlinear Coupling Terms
papers.summary: Doubly stochastic primal-dual updates for convex-concave saddle-point problems with smooth nonlinear coupling, with ergodic sublinear convergence and linear convergence of a restarted variant.

papers.title: Online Learning of Kronecker Preconditioners
papers.subtitle: Riemannian updates with two online objectives
papers.summary: Riemannian online updates for learning Kronecker-structured preconditioners using two feedback objectives.
